stemMd: What is the purpose of contrasting an original delay with a later excuse?

options.label: A
options.textMd: To forbid all projects with delayed benefits

options.label: B
options.textMd: To argue that newspapers cannot evaluate public projects

options.label: C
options.textMd: To make maintenance a purely aesthetic issue

options.label: D
options.textMd: To claim that a forecast is always correct

options.label: E
options.textMd: To distinguish a planned timeline from an unsupported defense after poor results

explanationMd: The distinction protects legitimate time-dependent plans while preserving accountability. A stated timetable can guide evaluation, whereas a new excuse may evade it. Neither immediate dismissal nor indefinite immunity is supported.

distractorRationale.a: The author accepts planned development over time.
distractorRationale.b: The passage challenges one interpretation, not public scrutiny itself.
distractorRationale.d: Monitoring is needed precisely because development can diverge.
